articles.title: BitGo’s WBTC move pushes LayerZero-to-Chainlink tally near $15 billion
articles.snippet: A migration wave followed a $292 million Kelp bridge exploit, with announced LayerZero-to-Chainlink moves now totaling $14.5 billion.

articles.title: Coldcard urges users to move bitcoin as exploit is still in progress
articles.snippet: The cold wallet maker said the flaw behind roughly $114 million in losses remains live, with specific models and firmware still exposed.

articles.title: Bitcoin rises toward $64,000 as Coldcard exploit, Strategy sales recede. ADA advances
articles.snippet: Bitcoin advanced as the market settled down following the weekend’s hack of Coldcard wallets and sales by Strategy even as sentiment remained in “extreme fear.”

articles.title: At least 15 attackers exploited Coldcard vulnerability: Galaxy
articles.snippet: Galaxy said that at least 15 different attackers have exploited the Coldcard vulnerability, which may have been avoided with just $2 worth of AI hardening, according to Dragonfly’s managing partner.

articles.title: Boltz pauses service after wave of AI-assisted hacking attempts
articles.snippet: The non-custodial protocol said attackers are discovering and adapting exploits faster than its small development team can identify and patch them.
